kinds.site: the site's standing text and layout. Exactly one, id "site"; create it once if site_state doesn't list it, then change it with item_update
kinds.entry: a dated post in one of the site's streams (its home section): with its own page (body in Markdown), or, with external_url, a listing that links to where it lives
kinds.card: a tile in the cards grid: projects, services, products. The grid's heading is the site's cards_title
kinds.note: a short dated line in the notes list (heading: the site's notes_title)

site.private: Require an owner or invited reader passkey to read published pages; only owner approval changes this
site.broker: plain-text brokerage line; Listing footer only; owner approval required
site.embed_sources: approved HTTPS player origins; adding or removing one requires owner approval
site.title: site name, shown top left and in the browser tab
site.tagline: the big headline on the home page
site.description: one or two sentences about the site, for search results and link previews; empty uses the tagline
site.about: the About section, plain text (no Markdown); a blank line starts a new paragraph
site.owner_name: the owner's name, shown in the footer
site.links: menu links top right: a list of {label, url}
site.hero: an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
site.hero_alt: a few words saying what the hero image shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a hero image
site.logo: the site's mark, a small square picture shown beside its name where the theme has room, and the browser tab's icon; an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
site.logo_alt: a few words saying what the mark shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a mark
site.follow_image: a small round photo of the owner beside the Follow link, where the theme shows one; empty for none; an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
site.follow_image_alt: a few words saying what the photo shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a photo
site.share_image: the picture shown when a link to the site is shared (X, messages): 1200x630 works everywhere; empty uses the hero image; an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
site.share_image_alt: a few words saying what the share picture shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a share picture
site.palette: the colours: one of the theme's palettes by name (theme_needs lists them); empty uses the theme's first
site.contact: how to reach or find them, where the theme shows it: {phone, email, address: {line1, line2, city, region, postcode, country}, map_link, social: [{kind, url}]}
site.hours: opening hours, where the theme shows them, in the site's timezone: {weekly, exceptions, note}
site.notice: a banner across the top for news that can't wait, e.g. Closed today for a burst pipe: {text, until: YYYY-MM-DD}; it disappears by itself after until; empty text for none
site.buttons: a list of big link buttons, where the theme has one (a link page): [{label, url, note}]
site.hero_caption: a line under the hero image where the theme shows one; empty for none
site.theme: the site's look: built-in, or a theme this site has (personal-homepage, product-page, or one installed from the catalog)
site.handle: the owner's X handle without the @, for themes with a Follow button; empty for none
site.follow_label: text of the Follow button where the theme has one; empty shows 'Follow on X'
site.logo_text: short name top left where the theme shows one; empty uses the title
site.footer_line: a line in the footer where the theme has one
site.contact_line: how to reach the owner, in the footer where the theme has one, e.g. DM me on X
site.cta_label: a hero button's text where the theme has one; empty hides it
site.cta_link: where that hero button goes: a full https:// link (e.g. https://example.com/page), a path on this site starting with / (e.g. /about), #name for a place on the same page, mailto:someone@example.com, or tel:+12025550100
site.timezone: the owner's time zone for times the site shows, e.g. America/New_York; default UTC
site.cards_aside: a card group shown after the others under its own heading, each card a whole link (e.g. Open source); empty for none
site.cta2_label: a second hero button's text, where the theme has one; empty hides it
site.cta2_link: where the second hero button goes, e.g. /#writing: a full https:// link (e.g. https://example.com/page), a path on this site starting with / (e.g. /about), #name for a place on the same page, mailto:someone@example.com, or tel:+12025550100
site.streams: the kinds of entries the site has, each its own home section: 1 to 64 {id, title, byline, layout, link_label, dated_addresses, sort}. sort is date (default) or title; feeds and feature latest remain chronological. The first is where an entry goes when it names no stream
site.archive: combined archive at /archive/: opt-in, owner approval required
site.cards_nav: the cards section's menu item; empty uses its heading
site.cards_anchor: the cards section's id on the home page; empty uses cards
site.sections: home page sections in order: stream ids, cards, notes, about; entries means every stream not listed by id. Leave one out to hide it. A section with nothing published (or an empty About) is hidden anyway
site.card_groups: what kind each card group is, for looks that show kinds differently: [{name, style}], name as in the cards' group; style is faq (each card a question, its description the answer), steps (numbered, in sort order), reviews (each description a quote, the card's name who said it), list (plain rows) or empty (the look's usual cards)
site.strings: the look's own words, to change any of them (e.g. another language): {name: words}; empty keeps the default. Names and defaults: back_to_top "Back to top", read_full_entry "Read the full entry", last_update "Last update", all "All", all_of "All of", is_separate "is separate", here "here", home "Home", all_writing "All writing", feed "Feed", follow "Follow", on_x "on X", by "by", for "for", also_on "Also on", or_email "or email", filter_projects "Filter projects", tags "Tags", search "Search writing", nothing_yet "Nothing here yet.", not_found_title "Not found", not_found_heading "Nothing here.", not_found_text "That page doesn't exist.", not_found_link "Back to the start.", open_now "Open now", closed_now "Closed now", closed "Closed", until "until", opens "opens", directions "Get directions", call "Call", email "Email", rsvp_by "RSVP by", upcoming "Coming up", earlier "Earlier", changed "Changed", cancelled "Cancelled", hours "Hours", contact "Contact", schedule "Schedule", meets "When we meet", holiday_hours "Holiday hours"

entry.stream: id of the stream it belongs to (see the site's streams); empty means the first stream
entry.title: required. the post's title
entry.date: required. the owner's local date, written YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-08
entry.summary: one or two sentences shown in lists
entry.body: the post itself, Markdown. Embed on its own line: !embed[Title](https://example.com/player). Images: ![what it shows](https://...) on a line of its own; each is copied into the site when you save
entry.cover: an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
entry.cover_alt: a few words saying what the cover image shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a cover image
entry.external_url: the full https:// address when the post lives elsewhere (an article on another site): the site lists it and links there instead of giving it a page; empty for a post on this site
entry.stats: optional number tiles shown on the entry's page: a list of {value, label}, e.g. [{"value": "12", "label": "commits"}]
entry.event: makes the entry an event, for themes that show events (times in the site's timezone): {start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, end, place: {name, address, map_link}, rsvp: {label, link, deadline}, schedule: [{time: HH:MM, title, note}], status: on|changed|cancelled}; null for an ordinary entry
entry.status: ready (can be published once approved) or draft (never shown; can't be sent for approval)
entry.slug: optional: the last part of the entry's page address, /<stream path>/<slug>/, e.g. how-it-works; unset, it is made once from the date and title (the title alone in a stream with dated_addresses false). Changing it moves the page, and the old address sends visitors to the new one

card.name: required. the card's title, e.g. a project or service name
card.link: a full https:// link (e.g. https://example.com/page), a path on this site starting with / (e.g. /about), #name for a place on the same page, mailto:someone@example.com, or tel:+12025550100; empty for none
card.link_label: text for the link; the link itself is shown if empty
card.image: an image: a full https:// link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 8 MB), copied into the site when you save, or a /media/... path this site gave you; empty for none
card.image_alt: a few words saying what the image shows, for people who can't see it; required when there is a image
card.badge_tone: the badge's colour where the theme has two: live (green) or building (tan)
card.badge: short text shown exactly as written in a badge on the card, e.g. Live, Beta, Paused; display only, it doesn't affect publishing; empty shows none
card.group: optional label for grouping cards (a menu section, Experience, FAQ); the built-in look doesn't show it
card.subtitle: a line under the name where the theme shows one: a role, an employer, a dish's style; empty for none
card.period: a time span where the theme shows one, e.g. 2019 – 2023; empty for none
card.price: a price shown exactly as written, e.g. $18, From $40, Market price; empty for none
card.tags: short labels shown on the card, e.g. ["V", "GF"]; empty for none
card.sort: order in the grid: lower comes first; default 100; ties sort by name
card.visibility: who sees it: public (the whole card), mention (its name and description only: no link, no picture; an entry may name it once in its summary and once in its body) or private (never shown; its name may not appear anywhere public, so the site refuses content that names it)

note.text: required. one line, e.g. what happened this week
note.date: required. the owner's local date, written YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-08
note.link: a full https:// link (e.g. https://example.com/page), a path on this site starting with / (e.g. /about), #name for a place on the same page, mailto:someone@example.com, or tel:+12025550100; empty for none
